Background / History
On December 8th, 1945 at the age of just sixteen, Elias "Eli" Mercer created a false id and enlisted in the U.S. Army. Assigned to logistics for a team of scientists reverse engineering German technology, he was caught in an experimental reactor catastrophe. To everyone else, Eli is impossibly fast. To Eli, everyone else is impossibly slow. Every time he pushes his powers, his personal timeline slips backward relative to the rest of the world. While hours pass for them, only minutes pass for him. Eighty-plus years have passed since, but he has personally lived barely two of them. He is still a teenager at war, and every sprint steals a little more of his future, making him younger relative to the world he is desperately trying to protect.
